After receiving the appeal form, I will send a response to the member with the required information and instructions on how to proceed with the appeal. 

Please note that the member's denial notice date is not provided in the ticket, so I will assume it was sent shortly after the claim was denied on August 27, 2026. The 180-day appeal window will be calculated from this date. 

The response to the member will include the following information:
- The reason for the claim denial
- The instructions on how to file a first-level appeal
- The deadline for filing the appeal (180 days from the denial notice date)
- The offer to provide the appeal form (FORM-APP-1)
- The contact information for further assistance

Once I receive the appeal form, I will send the response to the member and mark the ticket as resolved.
